slice: 34-D 0x0013 igBoundary2d grammar pin + typed audit-only decoder
summary: Dedicated probe pinned the 0x0013 grammar on 20/20 records: 0x67 is a fixed per-segment tag (segment_count groups of tag+4xf64, 33B each from +28), count field is u32 at +22 (= trailer member_count), btf == 49+41n exactly, anchor point inside segment bbox 20/20, and trailer member refs (u32 oid + u16 class 0x00CB + u16 sub 13/12/12) resolve to same-stream canonical igLine2d records whose geometry equals segments[i] forward on 60/60 members - proving association semantics. Landed decode_igboundaries/decode_igboundary_at (9 validation rules, 16 unit tests, panic-safety entries), fully-typed DTO DecodedIgBoundary2dRecord with closed_loop, SheetGeometry::decoded_igboundaries pipeline field, byte-audit Decoded claim, schema needles, and cross-fixture ratchet test (5/10/5 exact per-fixture counts). No normalized geometry emission (would double-count member lines); no writer change. Also fixed stale registered=5 assertion in geometry_fixture_availability_report_line_is_human_readable (34-A follow-up latent failure). All five pre-commit gates green (build/test/clippy/fmt/missing-docs 0==0).
